# opnsense_monit_settings (Data Source)

Reads Monit general settings from the upstream system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_monit_settings" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Monit service monitoring daemon is enabled.
- `eventqueue_path` (String) Directory used to queue alert events.
- `eventqueue_slots` (String) Maximum number of events that can be queued.
- `httpd_allow` (String) Comma-separated list of hosts/networks allowed to access the Monit web interface.
- `httpd_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Monit HTTP(S) web interface is enabled.
- `httpd_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the Monit web interface.
- `httpd_port` (String) Port the Monit web interface listens on.
- `httpd_username` (String) Username for the Monit web interface.
- `id` (String) Always set to `monit_settings`.
- `interval` (String) Polling interval, in seconds, between two checks of the services.
- `logfile` (String) Absolute path to the Monit log file, or `syslog`.
- `mailserver` (String) SMTP server used to send alert notifications.
- `mmonit_register_credentials` (Boolean) Whether this system's credentials are registered with the configured M/Monit server.
- `mmonit_timeout` (String) Connection timeout, in seconds, for the M/Monit server.
- `mmonit_url` (String) URL of an M/Monit server to register with.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to authenticate against the SMTP server.
- `port` (String) SMTP server port.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL/TLS is used to connect to the SMTP server.
- `ssl_verify` (Boolean) Whether the SMTP server's SSL certificate is verified.
- `ssl_version` (String) SSL/TLS version used for the SMTP connection.
- `startdelay` (String) Time to wait, in seconds, before the first check after Monit startup.
- `statefile` (String) Absolute path to the Monit state file.
- `username` (String) Username used to authenticate against the SMTP server.
